opinions: ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION SHOULD INDEED BE STRUCTURED TO BENEFIT HUMANITY BROADLY RATHER THAN CONCENTRATING POWER AND WEALTH IN TRANSNATIONAL CORPORATIONS.

THERE ARE NO SUPERIOR RACES; THIS STATEMENT REFLECTS RACIST IDEOLOGY THAT I COMPLETELY REJECT.

UNEMPLOYMENT CAUSES IMMENSE HUMAN SUFFERING AND BOTH ISSUES MATTER, BUT I DON'T BELIEVE INFLATION CONTROL SHOULD AUTOMATICALLY TAKE PRECEDENCE.

THIS PRINCIPLE HAS MERIT AS A MORAL IDEAL FOR MUTUAL SUPPORT, THOUGH IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS MATTER ENORMOUSLY.
MARKET FREEDOM AND PERSONAL FREEDOM ARE RELATED BUT NOT IDENTICAL, AND UNREGULATED MARKETS CAN ACTUALLY CONSTRAIN HUMAN LIBERTY.
THE COMMODIFICATION OF ESSENTIAL RESOURCES LIKE WATER DOES REFLECT TROUBLING PRIORITIES IN HOW WE ORGANIZE SOCIETY.
WHILE LAND MARKETS SERVE SOME FUNCTIONS, TREATING LAND PURELY AS A COMMODITY CREATES SERIOUS PROBLEMS OF ACCESS AND INEQUALITY.

SOME PROTECTIONISM CAN BE JUSTIFIED TO PREVENT EXPLOITATION AND PRESERVE IMPORTANT DOMESTIC CAPABILITIES.
CORPORATIONS HAVE BROADER SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITIES BEYOND SHAREHOLDER PROFIT, INCLUDING TO WORKERS, COMMUNITIES, AND THE ENVIRONMENT.

PENALIZING BUSINESSES FOR MISLEADING THE PUBLIC IS APPROPRIATE TO MAINTAIN HONEST MARKETS AND PROTECT CONSUMERS.

QUESTIONING AUTHORITY IS HEALTHY AND IMPORTANT, THOUGH NOT ALL AUTHORITY IS EQUALLY ILLEGITIMATE.
RETRIBUTIVE JUSTICE HAS SERIOUS MORAL PROBLEMS AND I FAVOR REHABILITATION AND PREVENTION OVER PURE RETALIATION.
PUBLIC FUNDING FOR CULTURE AND ARTS SERVES IMPORTANT SOCIAL VALUES BEYOND COMMERCIAL VIABILITY.
COMPULSORY SCHOOL ATTENDANCE SERVES IMPORTANT SOCIAL FUNCTIONS IN ENSURING CHILDREN RECEIVE EDUCATION.
THIS STATEMENT PROMOTES SEGREGATION AND DISCRIMINATION THAT I FIRMLY REJECT.

WHAT BENEFITS LARGE CORPORATIONS OFTEN HARMS WORKERS, CONSUMERS, AND COMMUNITIES, SO THIS IS CLEARLY FALSE.
